name: Return or exchange wrong item
description: Customers want to return or exchange items that were the wrong model, color, or size, or that don't fit or aren't compatible, for a refund or the correct replacement.

name: Claim warranty on faulty item
description: Customers want to file a warranty claim or get a repair for a faulty, broken, or defective item (including replacements), often without the warranty card or after a service center denied the repair.

name: Verify phone/email to log in
description: Customers need help verifying their mobile number or email (including getting OTPs) to log in, sign up, or complete a purchase, including issues with international numbers or lost access to an old number.

name: Understand return policy and fees
description: Customers ask about return policies, why they must ship items back, return shipping and pickup options, and fees or deductions from return refunds, including requests to waive fees or reimburse courier costs.
mixed_with: Requests to waive return fees or get reimbursed for return shipping, plus one request to remove an unwanted warranty charge from an invoice

name: Return or replace defective item
description: Customers want to return, exchange, or get a refund or replacement for an item that is defective, faulty, or malfunctioning, including one case past the return window.

name: Understand delivery charges
description: Customers want to know the shipping cost and speed for an item, or why their order was charged a delivery fee instead of qualifying for free delivery.

name: Resolve a failed delivery
description: Customers want help with orders that didn't reach them properly — missed deliveries to reschedule, packages marked delivered but not received, wrong-address or split-order deliveries, tracking and courier contact details, and complaints about rude couriers.
mixed_with: A few unrelated item issues: a missing accessory and returning unwanted free items.

name: Learn how to order and receive
description: Customers want guidance on placing an order on the website and on how it will reach them, whether through delivery, scheduled or in-store pickup, or combining orders from different sellers into one shipment.
mixed_with: Placing an order and arranging pickup or delivery are both common; a smaller set asks to combine multi-seller orders to avoid double shipping charges.

name: Update order address details
description: Customers want to change the pickup or delivery address for an order, or add a new delivery address to their account.

name: Track a late delivery
description: Customers want to know where their delayed or unshipped order is, why it's late, when it will arrive, and in some cases want it expedited.

name: Get help installing an item
description: Customers want guidance on installing, assembling, or setting up a purchased item, including who is responsible for installation, whether installation affects the warranty, and whether wall mount accessories are included or available.

name: Clarify conflicting warranty terms
description: Customers want to know which warranty terms actually apply to an item when the retailer's website conflicts with the warranty card or the brand's website.

name: Dispute an order overcharge
description: Customers want unexpected extra charges or overcharges on an order explained and, in many cases, refunded or waived.

name: Return item for refund
description: Customers want to return damaged, faulty, or unsatisfactory items, mostly for a refund and occasionally for a replacement or a refunded return shipping charge.

name: Get faster delivery
description: Customers want to learn about or obtain expedited or faster shipping for an item or order, either before purchase or as an upgrade to an existing order.

name: Change account email address
description: Customers want to change, update, or add the email address linked to their account (or an order), often to regain login access after an email change.

name: Register item for warranty
description: Customers want to register a purchased item with the brand for warranty benefits or sign up for an extended warranty on it.

name: Reactivate an inactive account
description: Customers want to restore access to accounts that were deactivated or went inactive so they can log in or make purchases, while a few want to deactivate their account.

name: Check item warranty details
description: Customers want to find or access the warranty details for a purchased item, including coverage, warranty start date, and how changed warranty terms affect their item.

name: Get missing verification code
description: Customers are not receiving the verification code or link needed to complete a purchase or log into their account and want it resent or the issue fixed.

name: Replace item from tampered package
description: Customers received items in tampered or opened packages, sometimes damaged, used, or not working, and want to report it and get an exchange or replacement.

name: Cancel an order
description: Customers want to cancel orders that are still processing or unshipped, often because they no longer need them, found a better deal, or the online cancel button isn't working.

name: Check status of return refund
description: Customers who returned an item want to know the status of their refund, why it hasn't arrived, or how long it will take, and want delayed or missing refunds processed.

name: Check order status
description: Customers want to confirm an order was placed or processed and find out its current or shipping status, including understanding what displayed order statuses mean.

name: Get exchange offer discount
description: Customers want to learn about or have exchange (trade-in) offer discounts applied to new or existing orders, including missed or promised discounts.
mixed_with: A couple of requests for other discounts, such as a price-drop adjustment or an additional discount on an item.

name: Ship item to unavailable location
description: Customers want to know whether an item can be shipped to their country or location, often internationally, and to get it ordered or delivered despite it showing as unavailable there.

name: Unlock account after verification lockout
description: Customers want to regain access to their BrownBox account after it was locked or blocked due to too many failed verification code attempts.

name: Check and redeem loyalty points
description: Customers want to know how many loyalty points a purchase earned and how to redeem those points for discounts or items, including when a redemption fails on the website.

name: Pay or get refund via COD
description: Customers want to use Cash on Delivery for purchases (often when it's unavailable) or return COD-paid items and learn how and when their refund arrives.
mixed_with: Questions about how instant cashback offers work and refund modes for canceled orders.

name: Get out-of-stock item
description: Customers want to know when an out-of-stock item will be restocked or want help ordering an item that is currently unavailable.

name: Check if account needed to buy
description: Customers want to know whether they need an account to make a purchase, what the account requirements are, and how to create or verify one.

name: Explain inconsistent item pricing
description: Customers want to know why the same item appears at different prices across listings, pages, checkout, over time, or compared with what others paid, and sometimes want the discrepancy resolved.

name: Get invoice for an order
description: Customers want a missing or previously issued invoice for one or more past orders sent or resent to them.

name: Sign up with corporate email
description: Customers want to create a BrownBox account using a corporate email address, including cases where the address is rejected during sign-up.

name: Change or reset password
description: Customers want to change their account password or reset a forgotten password to regain access to their account.
